className.en-US: Class name of the root element.

direction.zh-CN: 条状进度条的方向，可选 `horizontal` 或 `vertical`。
direction.en-US: Direction of the line progress bar: `horizontal` or `vertical`.

format.zh-CN: 格式化函数，入参为当前显示的百分比（截断到 0 到 100，动画过程中为中间值），返回值渲染在环形进度条中心或条状进度条右侧。每次渲染都会调用，即使 `showInfo` 为 `false`。
format.en-US: Formatting function. It receives the shown percentage, clamped to 0-100 and animated during transitions, and its return value is rendered in the center of a circle or on the right of a line. It runs on every render, even when `showInfo` is `false`.

indeterminate.zh-CN: 是否为不确定状态。开启后 `percent` 不再控制进度长度，不显示文字，且不设置 `aria-valuenow`。
indeterminate.en-US: Whether the progress is indeterminate. When on, `percent` no longer controls the length, the text is hidden and `aria-valuenow` is omitted.

motion.zh-CN: 文字中的数字是否以动画过渡到新的 `percent`；关闭后直接跳到目标值。
motion.en-US: Whether the number in the text animates to the new `percent`. When off, it jumps to the target.

orbitStroke.zh-CN: 进度条轨道的填充色；未设置时由样式决定。
orbitStroke.en-US: Fill color of the track. When not set, the stylesheet decides it.

percent.zh-CN: 进度百分比；超出 0 到 100 的值会被截断。
percent.en-US: Progress percentage. Values outside 0-100 are clamped.

showInfo.zh-CN: 是否显示文字：环形显示在中间，条状显示在右侧。`size` 为 `small` 的环形进度条不显示文字。
showInfo.en-US: Whether to show the text: in the center of a circle, or on the right of a line. A circle with `size` `small` never shows the text.

size.zh-CN: 尺寸，可选 `default`、`small`（仅环形生效）或 `large`（仅条状生效）。

stroke.zh-CN: 填充色。数组形式为 `{ percent, color }` 的区间列表，`color` 可为任意 CSS 颜色或 Semi 色板名，如 `blue`、`orange-9`，未写色阶时取 5。
stroke.en-US: Fill color. An array is a list of `{ percent, color }` intervals, where `color` is any CSS color or a Semi palette name such as `blue` or `orange-9` (shade 5 when no shade is given).

strokeGradient.zh-CN: 是否在相邻颜色区间之间生成渐变色补齐颜色，仅在 `stroke` 为区间数组时生效。
strokeGradient.en-US: Whether to generate gradient colors between the intervals. Takes effect only when `stroke` is an array of intervals.

strokeLinecap.zh-CN: 环形进度条端点形状，可选 `round` 或 `square`；条状进度条不生效。
strokeLinecap.en-US: Line cap of the circle progress bar: `round` or `square`. Has no effect on a line progress bar.

strokeWidth.en-US: Stroke width of the circle progress bar.

width.zh-CN: 环形进度条的直径，仅 `type` 为 `circle` 时生效；未设置时，`size` 为 `small` 取 24，否则取 72。
width.en-US: Diameter of the circle progress bar, effective only when `type` is `circle`. When not set, it is 24 for size `small` and 72 otherwise.
